spans.s:
Pauñji-ṣṭha is the form in the Atharvaveda, the Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, and the taittirīya brāhmaṇa, of the word puñjiṣṭha, denoting ‘fisherman.’ It is probably a caste name, ‘son of a puñjiṣṭha,’ as the designation of a functional caste.
Foot notes x. 4, 9.
xxx. 8.
iii. 4, 5, 1, where Sāyaṇa glosses it with the word kaivarta, also probably the name of a functional caste.
